About this concept.

An independent design study

Veylan Aerospace and Sable are fictional brands created for a website concept by Joshua of Triple Four Studio. This work was not commissioned by, affiliated with or endorsed by Keres or any other aerospace or defense company.

The company story, product descriptions and illustration demonstrate a possible communication approach. They are not claims about an existing aircraft, verified performance or a real engineering programme. No customer relationships, flight results or certifications are implied.

Sable product visual

The opening aircraft image was generated for this fictional Sable concept. This is a generated still, not actual or generated flight-test video. The overhead product view was generated using the hero aircraft as its design reference. Both views and the simplified flight-map silhouette are creative studies, not validated aircraft designs.

Photography

Real aircraft photographs establish the aerospace context. The aircraft shown are not Veylan or Sable products, and the photographs do not imply a relationship with their manufacturers or operators.

Flight-test footage

Video excerpts show NASA’s X-59 flight testing, filmed June 5, 2026. Source: NASA / Armstrong Flight Research Center; photographer Lori Losey. This footage provides aerospace research context. The X-59 is not a Veylan or Sable aircraft, and NASA does not endorse this concept.
